plan.question: Do the small fixed-role row-aggregation repeat discrepancies measured in the schema3 audit propagate through guarded projection and row scaling into actual complete-row gradients and Adam updates under total_magnitude, while remaining inactive under none? The four round24 receipts report nonzero aggregation repeat distances at calls 0 and 1 (absolute maxima 8.24e-13 to 1.99e-12; relative distances 6.13e-7 to 1.13e-6), but zero raw-backward and fixed-operand-transform repeat distances and passing sampled observer/mutation checks. Magnitude AUC varies between 0.6148846559937464 and 0.6150147026807334; both runs have lower AUC and higher Logloss than the none comparator, whose AUC repeats at 0.6151021885074872. These are same-seed executions, not independent seed evidence. Retrieve implementation and state evidence needed for a bounded, same-state original-versus-fixed-order aggregation shadow comparison in both interventions, preserving mathematical row membership, masks, guards, forward computation and optimizer. Measure actual role, projection, scale, accumulated-gradient and Adam-step distances rather than inferring equality or divergence from sketches. Stable aggregation with persistent update variation would reject aggregation as a sufficient explanation; unchanged Adam steps despite role variation would weaken optimizer mediation. No performance improvement or established numerical cause is presumed.
missing_information: Candidate source bodies and exact row-aggregation, guarded-projection and row-scale definitions are unavailable in this query phase; hashes and declared source isolation do not independently verify these implementations. Resolve memory://agent-r0024 for the complete scoped prior analysis, including alternatives and negative trajectories; its conclusions remain provisional.

Exact actual operands, row indices, masks, accumulation order and per-row discrepancy distributions are missing. The small reported absolute differences do not establish meaningful amplification or identify a hardware/operator cause.

No exact common-state comparison of parameters, buffers, inputs, RNG and Adam state is exposed. Matching collision-prone cross-run sketches cannot establish equality; call1 parameter sketches match within the magnitude pair despite differing call0 gradient sketches.

Actual accumulated-gradient and actual Adam-update distances for original and fixed-order aggregation at identical starting state are missing. Separate propagation through the transform from final embedding-gradient accumulation and optimizer conditioning.

Observer no-op and scheduling controls for any new shadow implementation are needed. Existing fixed-real-tensor observer checks already pass in the sampled two-call scope; do not repeat the completed four-job audit unchanged or claim it excludes all observer effects.

The authorized tools expose resolve/read/search; model_files is empty and only retrieval-plan.json is editable. A later counted experiment interface and candidate-owned source access would be prerequisites for execution; do not modify host precision/determinism settings or train in this phase.

Refresh the charged resource ledger and final-suite reserve before any later experiment. The runtime snapshot is 39863.29309988022 seconds remaining with a 1760.9324324010606-second trial cap. The prior 18-cap final reserve plus 1408.7459459208485-second preparation allowance is an inherited planning convention, not a host assessment tariff; four additional capped jobs no longer fit that convention. A bounded diagnostic must retain necessary repetition and assessment resources.

Primary-source index searches for deterministic reduction aggregation numerical gradient Adam and gradient surgery conflict normalization returned no matches. This establishes a retrieval gap, not literature absence or novelty. No industry architecture card is requested because no retrieved external architecture resolves this numerical attribution question.

Independent paired seeds 43/44, per-user predictions and uncertainty estimates are unavailable. A numerical repair would not establish generalization benefit; any later training-wide causal claim needs aggregation-construction by intervention controls and repetition, with a frozen comparison suite before closed assessment.
